responsibility: This source file implements the default functions and constant tables behind the common target-hook interface. It supplies fallback logic for selecting the exception unwinding model (including generic, forced DWARF2, and forced SJLJ variants), a permissive default target option handler, an empty completion/value list for target-specific option enumerations, the sentinel empty_optimization_table, and the default multilib computation routine that preserves the built-in multilib result; these definitions are used to populate gcc_targetm_common when targets do not override the corresponding hooks.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the paired header, this .cc file provides the actual fallback code and data for common target hooks, implementing the default exception-unwind selectors, permissive option handler, empty option-values result, empty_optimization_table, and pass-through multilib calculator declared in the header.
